turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes, and I'll start with the only question that matters. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and why did my son find out from his phone in the middle of a class instead of from a phone call to me?
Thanks for coming in. I owe you an apology: the zero went in before I called you.
Okay. That's your own school's procedure, 4.2, and I'm writing down that you said it. Now, on what basis was the zero entered at all?
I am withdrawing the zero today. Owen does a private supervised rewrite at lunch. Nothing goes on his record. I will email you that tonight.

The zero comes off today, nothing on his record, and an email tonight; I'm writing all three down. What I haven't heard is a basis for a rewrite, Hale. If you're withdrawing the zero, why does Owen owe you anything at lunch?
Here it is in writing, signed.
I'll read every line of it, and I'll keep the original. A signature isn't a reason, Hale. I asked why Owen owes you a rewrite, and I'm still waiting.
Thank you for your time, Ms. Kalinowski.

We're not done, Hale. You've withdrawn the zero and promised nothing goes on file, but you're still sending my son to a supervised rewrite without telling me why. Answer that, or my next stop is the principal's office.

Then I'll put the question to the principal, today, with your signed page in my hand. The zero is off and nothing goes on file; you've said that, and I'm holding you to it. The rewrite doesn't happen until someone gives me a reason for it.
